skills_versions: Credential prerequisites: NSE 4 FortiOS; NSE 5 or NSE 6 in any track; NSE 7 in the same track as the NSE 5 or NSE 6
Credential completion: Core Practical plus one Elective Practical within 1 year
Credential validity: 2 years from second practical
Core status: Available; onsite at selected Fortinet offices/events; US$800; English; task count/time communicated per exam
Core products: FortiGate 7.6, FortiManager 7.6, FortiAnalyzer 7.6, FortiAuthenticator 8.0
Practical task types: hands-on configuration, troubleshooting, drag-and-drop, multiple choice; partial credit for selected tasks
Retake: 30 days after unsuccessful practical; passed exams cannot be retaken
Secure Networking elective: Coming Soon, expected December 2026
Application Security elective: Coming Soon, expected January 2027
Security Operations elective: Coming Soon, expected March 2027
Eligible existing holders may use transitional NSE 8 Recertification Exam through January 31, 2027
upcoming_announcements: Transitional NSE 8 Recertification Exam closes January 31, 2027
